tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List this organization's ET Ducky agents (Windows and Linux endpoints) with OS, agent version, online state, last heartbeat, last signed-in user, isolation state and tags. Sorted by hostname.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One agent with its latest health sample (CPU, memory, free space on C:, uptime, pending reboot, make and model) and its number of active alerts.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Alerts raised for this organization's agents, newest first.

tools.name: get_fleet_summary
tools.description: Counts for this organization: agents, online, offline, Windows, Linux, other OS, isolated, and active alerts by severity.
